headline: AI Tool Access Review: 6 Questions Before Connecting Business Data
description: A practical educational review for small-business teams before granting an AI tool access to files, inboxes, calendars, customer records, or internal systems.
claimBoundary: Educational access-review material only — not legal, compliance, privacy, security, procurement, or production authorization advice. No client results, certifications, rankings, savings, or guarantees are claimed.

reviewQuestions.name: Purpose
reviewQuestions.text: What specific task needs this access?

reviewQuestions.name: Minimum Access
reviewQuestions.text: Can the task work with fewer files, fields, permissions, or systems?

reviewQuestions.name: Data Boundary
reviewQuestions.text: Does the connection avoid secrets, credentials, sensitive personal data, and restricted information?

reviewQuestions.name: Owner
reviewQuestions.text: Who approves the connection and remains accountable?

reviewQuestions.name: Visibility
reviewQuestions.text: Can the team review what the tool reads, creates, changes, and sends?

reviewQuestions.name: Exit Path
reviewQuestions.text: Can access be revoked, tokens rotated, exports removed, and changes reviewed?
